desc: Prove the correspondence between adjacent-removal sequences and noncrossing matchings of sequence indices.
Derive the parity constraints on pairs and characterize which index may remain unmatched for odd N.
Prove that an even segment’s optimum equals the sum of its largest half minus the sum of its smallest half via balanced signs and adjacent opposite-sign reductions.
Implement an O(N log N) two-heap computation of even-prefix and even-suffix optimum values, then maximize valid odd-index splits.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases (N=2, all equal, monotone, odd length).
Analyze Python memory use, integer safety, and time complexity.
